findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set `enable_key_rotation`, which defaults to false. Long-lived key material protecting a large volume of historical audit logs is never rotated, so compromise of a single key version exposes the entire audit record and the key fails common compliance baselines requiring annual rotation.
